text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with
Silence
Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Those plushies... Spe was talking about
them the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She points toward a claw machine filled
with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She said they've been really popular
recently.
Some of her friends have them
too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to! I was just thinking out
loud...
